title: SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.18963v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Edge-cloud speculative decoding moves autoregressive drafting to an edge device while a larger cloud model verifies draft tokens in parallel, so that edge drafting and cloud verification overlap under a synchronous draft-verify schedule. Beyond low-latency local networks, however, the next verification request of that schedule can be sent only after the previous reply arrives, so every round still waits out a full round trip, and throughput falls as the network RTT grows. To recover this loss, we present SpecRelay, an edge-cloud LLM inference system that addresses this cost at two levels: it amortizes round trips when cloud verification is necessary and avoids them when local reasoning suffices. translated_title: SpecRelay：在边云协同投机解码中摊销或规避往返延迟
translated_abstract: 边云协同投机解码将自回归草稿生成转移到边缘设备上，同时由更大的云端模型并行验证草稿 token，从而在同步的草稿-验证调度下实现边缘草稿生成与云端验证的重叠执行。然而，在超出低延迟本地网络的场景中，该调度下的下一个验证请求只能在上一次回复到达之后才能发送，因此每一轮仍需等待一次完整的往返，吞吐量随网络 RTT 增大而下降。为弥补这一损失，我们提出了 SpecRelay——一个边缘云 LLM 推理系统，它在两个层面应对这一开销：当需要云端验证时摊销往返延迟，当本地推理已足够时规避往返延迟。对于必须依赖云端的查询，异步验证流水线在先前回复尚未返回期间，保持固定预算的草稿树持续在途，并且云端在目标模型前向传播之前拒绝过期请求……
tldr: SpecRelay 提出一种边云协同 LLM 推理系统，在需要云端验证时通过异步验证流水线摊销网络往返延迟，在本地推理足够时直接规避往返，从而在高 RTT 网络下恢复投机解码的吞吐量。
en_tdlr: SpecRelay is an edge-cloud LLM inference system that recovers speculative decoding throughput under high network RTT by amortizing round trips via an asynchronous verification pipeline when cloud verification is necessary, and avoiding them when local reasoning suffices.
